{
  "study": "Saslow et al. 2023",
  "design": "parallel 2-arm",
  "country": "United States",
  "duration": "4 months",
  "n_randomized_total": "83",
  "experimental_arm": {
    "label": "VLC diet",
    "intervention_description": "Very low-carbohydrate diet, decreasing carbohydrate intake to 20-35 nonfiber g/day, aiming for nutritional ketosis",
    "n_randomized": "43",
    "n_analyzed": "NR",
    "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.32%",
    "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.07%",
    "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SE",
    "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.09%",
    "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.45%",
    "hba1c_final_mean": "5.77%",
    "hba1c_final_sd": "0.08%"
  },
  "control_arm": {
    "label": "DASH diet",
    "intervention_description": "DASH dietary pattern, limiting sodium to <2,300 mg/day and fat intake to 20-30% of calories/day",
    "n_randomized": "40",
    "n_analyzed": "NR",
    "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.14%",
    "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.07%",
    "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SE",
    "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.10%",
    "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.07%",
    "hba1c_final_mean": "5.97%",
    "hba1c_final_sd": "0.07%"
  }
}
